Middle-brain holon telemetry, lifecycle, and stream convergence management.

Commands:
  status    Display middle-brain holon vitality, stream hydrator capacities, and river convergence metrics

Usage:
  zqk system holon [flags]
  zqk system holon [command]

Aliases:
  holon, holons

Available Commands:
  status      Display middle-brain holon vitality, stream hydrator capacities, and river convergence metrics

Flags:
      --engine          Output ambient engine runtime telemetry report
  -f, --format string   Output format (table, json) (default "table")
      --json            Output telemetry snapshot as JSON

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk system holon [command] --help" for more information about a command.
